mintAuthority.headline: The controller checks backing, but issuer-controlled timelocked governance can authorize an uncapped minter.
mintAuthority.summary: Verified USDfr.mint(address,uint256) is onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) but performs _mint without the ReserveManager backing check used by the current controller. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can authorize a different minter while accrual is idle. This authorization path makes economic issuance unbounded; the two-day upgrade delay does not impose an immutable backing cap. At Ethereum block 26197399 the controller remains the sole minter and the timelock remains the sole token admin/upgrader. Signed loan facts and continuous internal accounting do not establish independent reserve reconciliation, attester key independence or prudential supervision.

controls.label: USDfr MintRedeemController
controls.capDescription: Every user mint is gated by KYC and the reserve-to-liability invariant; authenticated credit interest may create yield liabilities through authorized modules. Upgrade authority can replace this logic.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z), the complete token RoleGranted/RoleRevoked/RoleAdminChanged census from deployment block 26006832, followed by hasRole verification, identifies the controller as the sole MINTER_ROLE holder. The controller is unpaused, backingInvariantHolds=true and previewRedeem(1e18) returns 1e6 USDC with 1e18 USDfr burned. Its CREDIT_ROLE belongs only to WaterfallEngine, while LOSS_BURNER_ROLE belongs to ReserveManager and DefaultManager. No new minter, financial assurance or immutable mint cap is inferred.

controls.label: Forest Road governance timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26197399 (2026-10-15T10:44:59Z), complete deployment-to-pin role logs and hasRole reads retain the timelock as sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE holder on USDfr, controller, ReserveManager, ClaimBridge and AttestationOracle. getMinDelay=172800. The timelock is self-administered; FRGovernor alone holds PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE, and EXECUTOR_ROLE is open to the zero address. Governor wiring points to this timelock and GroveVotesAggregator, with a one-day voting delay, two-day voting period and one-million-GROVE proposal threshold. Issuer disclosure still states Forest Road treasury controls governance; public execution of an already-approved operation is not permissionless proposal authority.

review.evidence: Fresh Ethereum block 26197399, hash 0x2bff3ac61a5d73489280644fbef154289380ad03d8135a65efdd7a433c6a2c36, timestamp 2026-10-15T10:44:59Z, keyless RPC https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com. Complete role-event census from block 26006832 across token, controller, manager, oracle, ClaimBridge, timelock and governor contains 53 events; every remaining membership was independently re-read with hasRole at the pin. Token: MINTER=controller; DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER=timelock; GUARDIAN=operations Safe 0x297e88c997c2e0edf70a5f817aadca2858aa6c04. Controller: DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER=timelock; GUARDIAN=operations Safe; CREDIT=WaterfallEngine 0xed7f98103ef13d27d572cb4b790e6cf54c27b063; LOSS_BURNER=ReserveManager and DefaultManager 0xd08fa0dc72232c9cf5c8c6a0c4ed9e0074037263. ReserveManager: DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER/RESERVE_ADMIN=timelock; GUARDIAN=operations Safe; CONTROLLER=controller; CREDIT=WaterfallEngine and DefaultManager. ClaimBridge: DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER=timelock; GUARDIAN/ORIGINATOR=operations Safe; CREDIT=WaterfallEngine and DefaultManager. Oracle: DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER=timelock; GUARDIAN=operations Safe; CREDIT=ClaimBridge, WaterfallEngine and DefaultManager; ATTESTER=0x759c2cd90594fdb114c5d37c5c3ea78a0033ed35 and 0xe2e544eded1189b8a5bda86a6f474011a397efb0. Oracle thresholds remain one for kinds 0/1 and two for kinds 2-9. Timelock: DEFAULT_ADMIN=self; PROPOSER/CANCELLER=FRGovernor; EXECUTOR=zero address. No RoleAdminChanged event was returned in the complete interval. Operations Safe is currently 2-of-4, with owners 0xe6e7d3c6379ad80de02f26ccc72605d0f70d5201, 0x7961523a81cc89beb33f2f140255213a6433cdbd, 0x10b23b2f2a5f6bc4ce0c68a5f65c248c1129831 and 0x2d1da1037d2a3b7a49f343212c0b00714ae27975; getModulesPaginated returns an empty list with the terminal sentinel. This is operational guardian/origination custody, not independent governance or attester custody. USDfr's complete 376 Transfer events comprise 36 mints and six burns; their exact net 5536330484442284742571821 equals pinned physical totalSupply. This arithmetic is not transaction-by-transaction financial assurance. ERC-1967 token/controller/manager/oracle/ClaimBridge/governor implementation slots were also re-pinned; no implementation drift from the reviewed source was found. The historical R17 review at block 26124975 retained 29 mints/six burns with exact net 5142565558477829991308833, reviewed transaction inputs and bootstrap revocations, and found no unexplained historical issuance or upgrade. Its governor-root finding remains: FRGovernor upgrades onlyGovernance, rejects pointer-only timelock replacement, and reads immutable GroveVotesAggregator whose GROVE and sGROVE vote sources remain timelock-upgradeable. No fresh independent electorate, attester-human independence, execution certificate, financial reconciliation or governed-issuance uplift is asserted. Disclosed open economic findings remain fork scenarios, not evidence of a live loss.
